body:
I didn't realise from the review that we don't have access to the render options inside the Panel but only to the raw render option provided by InstantSearch not the connector. The current implem is nice but not good enough IMO. We should have access to the same set of options that the wrapped widget provide (e.g. list of facets with count). One solution proposed by @francoischalifour was a `getRenderingOptions` function implemented by all the widgets. But it's adds one (more) method to the widget API surface for a pretty small use case. Would be better to find an alternative that allow the panel to be hooked inside the widget itself.

The previous API was also convenient because the `autoHideContainer` was automatically computed. Right now it's on the user to implement it. Would be nice to have a default implementation of the that will automatically read the value from the render options (this is how React & Vue works). The magic is far from what I prefer to implement but we have to admit that it's way more convenient for the users. With this implementation I think we'll have users asking how to hide the Panel.
